title: An idea becomes a connected system — Egyptian Register Painting preview

scenes.title: Idea and procession
scenes.purpose: Two registers show the subject: in the upper register a larger figure (symbolic scale) raises a sun disc, the idea; in the lower register four figures walk in procession carrying disc nodes, and a cord joins them into one connected system.
visuals: Cool gypsum/limestone field #E3E6DE with static fixed-seed SVG grain (a scene-dependent refresh of the earlier warm swatch)
Frieze border bands in blue, linen, red and green at top and bottom; #3B2D23 register baselines at y=310 and y=580
Upper register: headline copy on the left, a larger standing man (long kilt, ochre fillet) raising an ochre and red sun disc, and an empty inscription column frame on the right
Lower register: three men and one woman (ochre skin, sheath dress) in the canonical pose (profile head and legs, frontal shoulders and eye), each carrying a blue and ochre disc node
Gestures: figure 1 swings its back arm and lifts its disc; figure 2 presents with both hands; figure 3 raises its back hand in adoration; figure 4 lifts its disc
An ochre cord drawn through the settled nodes
HTML caption band below the registers

beats.development: Headline lines wipe in. The empty inscription frame draws. DrawSVG draws the figure contours in reading order, upper figure first and then the procession left to right; the last contour completes at 0.79s, inside the next beat.

The last contours complete. Each figure's flat mineral fills then wipe in left to right through its own clip, only after that figure's contour is done; the fills finish at 1.38s, inside the next beat.

The upper figure raises the sun disc. The four figures step 42px to the right in three measured x-only steps while shoulder and elbow pivots lift their discs to one height. The caption reveals at 1.45–1.9s. At 2.42–2.67s the cord draws through the settled nodes.
captions: ONE THOUGHT · MANY HANDS · ONE WOVEN NETWORK

beats.development: Hold on the settled, fully legible composition.

findings: All motion settles by 2.67s, before the 2.7s legibility requirement.
No figure's fill wipe starts before its contour finishes (the last contour ends at 0.79s and the last fill runs 1.0–1.38s).
Background, grain, border bands and baselines stay fixed for the whole preview.
justifiedHolds: 2.67–3.0s: a final reading hold on the complete headline, procession and caption.

notes: The figures are original, illustrative drawings in the register convention; they make no claim of archaeological authenticity.
The inscription column stays empty because no verified text was supplied.
Every tween is a fromTo on one paused GSAP timeline at window.__timelines.video.

Background refresh: field changed from #EEE3BB to cool limestone #E3E6DE under the scene_dependent background policy. No source frames matched and there are no preview recipes, so the original style craft is kept.
